Messages.Author: Fred Banville
Messages.Body:
Hi,

My question is about Toreador Inner Circle Alexandra. Does her
power to tap/untap another toreador still works when she is in
torpor? The card doesn't specifiy.

Thanx in advance.

Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
In article <338CF3...@ift.ulaval.ca>,

banv...@ift.ulaval.ca wrote:
> My question is about Toreador Inner Circle Alexandra. Does her
> power to tap/untap another toreador still works when she is in
> torpor? The card doesn't specifiy.

Since it doesn't specify, her special ability continues to apply
as long as she is controlled - Torpor or not.

Messages.Author: Dave Green
Messages.Body:
Demos (tagg...@osu.edu) wrote:
: Can Alexandra untap herself?

By card text, "Alexandra may tap or untap another ready
Toreador," so no, she cannot untap herself.
